business_summary: Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells adhesives, primers, hardeners, and other adhesive related products mainly used by footwear manufacturers. It also engages in provision of administrative support services, as well as acts as the distribution agent for chemical products. In addition, the company offers OEM service to chemical companies. It operates in the People's Republic of China, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and Bangladesh. The company was formerly known as Infinity Chemical Holdings Company Limited and changed its name to Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited in February 2016. Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Macau. Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of All Reach Investments Limited.
business_summary_ko: Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited는 투자지주회사로 신발제조업체에서 주로 사용하는 접착제, 프라이머, 경화제 등 기타 접착제 관련 제품을 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 행정 지원 서비스 제공과 화학제품 유통 대행 업무도 담당하고 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 화학 회사에 OEM 서비스를 제공합니다. 중화인민공화국, 베트남, 인도네시아, 인도, 방글라데시에서 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Infinity Chemical Holdings Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2016년 2월에 Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited는 1987년에 설립되었으며 마카오에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited는 All Reach Investments Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
